about: Text outlines converted from the Libre Baskerville Regular font, version 2.005, by Pablo Impallari and Rodrigo Fuenzalida, under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. This file is a converted subset (a Modified Version under the licence); see OFL.txt and CREDITS.txt.
units: em = 1; y up; baseline at y = 0; glyphs start at x = 0 (pen position)
path: SVG-like path: M x y, L x y, Q cx cy x y, C c1x c1y c2x c2y x y, Z; a command letter may be left out when it repeats (after M, a repeat means L). Filled contours run counter-clockwise, holes clockwise; each hole follows the contour that holds it.
kernNote: kern[left][right] = signed kerning in thousandths of an em. Look up the pair as written first; when it is not listed, use the pair of the base letters (the first character of each NFD form); when neither is listed, the pair has no kerning.
